title: Super Research: Answering Highly Complex Questions with Large Language Models through Super Deep and Super Wide Research
authors: Yubo Dong; Nianhao You; Yuxuan Hou; Zixun Sun; Yue Zhang; Liang Zhang; Siyuan Zhao; Hehe Fan
why_relevant: Proposes a benchmark for complex deep/wide research tasks involving reconciliation of conflicting evidence over many retrieval steps, touching tangentially on robustness and uncertainty expression.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on long-horizon complex research capability rather than core robustness issues (noise, attacks, calibration) under unreliable evidence.
